key_insight: PRISM separates consultation-state estimation from action selection to better handle unexpected patient disclosures and topic shifts in online medical dialogue.
clinical_relevance: More reliable tracking of evolving consultation context could help AI systems support coherent triage conversations, though clinical benefit remains unproven.
method: Maintain an evolving probability distribution over latent consultation states.
Select actions using the most probable state.
Generate responses through a separate response-realization step.
evidence_signal: The study examined 16 medical dialogue datasets and reports a 22.40-percentage-point gain in clinical decision accuracy and a 5.51-point BERTScore_F1 improvement over the strongest baseline.
watch_item: Benchmark accuracy and language-quality gains do not establish patient safety or real-world clinical effectiveness.
paper_title: Accounting for Irregular State Transitions through Belief Estimation in Online Medical Consultation
